test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Udit is an immediate neighbour of both Uday and Unnati. Umesh is sitting second to the right of Unnati. Utpal is sitting third to the left of Uday. Utsav is an immediate neighbour of both Umesh and Uday. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Umesh and Unnati?
solution:
**Given: **Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) Umesh is sitting second to the right of Unnati.

2) Utsav is an immediate neighbour of both Umesh and Uday. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75befb70f031379b052ffda7d2a80c4d939d12be04840aee4f3b935391d012c3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9b757149e3239b42a589c09b8add6393acf4293b15c51d539a8eb405f9f0954.png] 

3) Utpal is sitting third to the left of Uday.

4) Udit is an immediate neighbour of both Uday and Unnati.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f872d4e88f2f69f01b7aaad5f053cc8c78ae4f9cd64708e7a69e6c9a1dd362e4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/383e6a698b2a11c7068079e9a3a9a8ed526ff18daf0bf38f6bb9acb1ed1f5649.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Utpal is an immediate neighbour of both Umesh and Unnati.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
